products.name: Recital Readiness Board
products.product: A focused dance studio recital readiness tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent dance studios producing multi-class recitals
products.problem: Routines, music edits, dancer participation, costumes, shoes, quick changes, rehearsal calls, volunteers, tickets, program details, venue access, and backstage plans mature across many class and parent records.
products.valueProposition: Turns dance studio recital readiness tracking into a visible operating queue so every recital number and performer reaches show day with approved music, participation, costume, call time, quick-change, volunteer, and backstage dependencies verified.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets dance recital planning software, recital costume tracker, dance backstage checklist, and dance studio recital management searches.
